latest.notes: Online Audio now stays current on the airing machine. This is the real reason the weather was two days old: a cached online file was downloaded once at app launch and then never refreshed again for the life of the process — External and FTP audio both poll, Online Audio had no equivalent. Setting a freshness limit on an entry now also enables automatic refresh: the file is re-downloaded once it reaches half its limit, so it is comfortably current whenever it airs. Entries with no limit keep the previous behaviour (fetched once, refreshed on demand), so nothing downloads in the background unless you ask for it. Pairs with the freshness limit added in 0.5.23 — together they mean fresh content airs and stale content is skipped.
